name: web3agent
description: Web3 MCP proxy for AI agents: DeFi swaps, bridges, Orbs orders, market data, wallets, and confirmation-gated writes.
long_description: Web3Agent gives local AI agents a single MCP surface for EVM execution and DeFi workflows: token resolution, balances, swaps, bridges, Orbs orders, market data, research, wallet lifecycle, and confirmation-gated writes. It is self-custodial by default and keeps wallet secrets out of agent-visible MCP flows unless explicitly enabled.

chain_id.title: Default chain ID
chain_id.description: Default EVM chain ID. Defaults to Base mainnet (8453).

confirm_writes.title: Require write confirmations
confirm_writes.description: Require explicit confirmation before write operations execute.

etherscan_api_key.title: Etherscan API key
etherscan_api_key.description: Optional Etherscan API key for Etherscan-backed explorer tools.

zerox_api_key.title: 0x API key
zerox_api_key.description: Optional 0x API key for 0x swap plugin support.

lifi_api_key.title: LI.FI API key
lifi_api_key.description: Optional LI.FI API key for higher-rate bridge and fallback routing.

coingecko_api_key.title: CoinGecko API key
coingecko_api_key.description: Optional CoinGecko API key for higher-rate market data.

ccxt_config_path.title: CCXT config path
ccxt_config_path.description: Optional local path to a CCXT account config JSON file.

ows_passphrase.title: OWS passphrase
ows_passphrase.description: Optional Open Wallet Standard vault passphrase for persisted local wallets.

resume_state_secrets.title: Resume-state secret ring
resume_state_secrets.description: Optional comma-separated random secrets of at least 32 characters shared by every replica for Orbs, LI.FI, and 0x resume-state authentication and rotation. Required on Windows for prepared operations.

prompts.name: safe_first_steps
prompts.description: Guide a user through safe read-only Web3Agent discovery before attempting any write operation.
prompts.text: List the available Web3Agent tools, identify the configured chain, and recommend three safe read-only actions to try before any transaction or wallet write.

prompts.name: quote_swap_without_execution
prompts.description: Prepare a cautious swap quote workflow that explicitly avoids execution.
prompts.text: Ask the user for source token, destination token, amount, and chain if any are missing. Then quote the swap without executing anything, and explain route, expected output, slippage assumptions, and risks.

prompts.name: wallet_activity_review
prompts.description: Review a wallet with read-only explorer and balance tools.
prompts.text: Ask the user for a wallet address and chain if missing. Then summarize balances, recent transactions, notable counterparties, and risk signals using only read-only Web3Agent tools.

prompts.name: yield_due_diligence
prompts.description: Investigate yield opportunities and explain protocol risks before capital allocation.
prompts.text: Ask the user for target chain and minimum APY if missing. Then find yield opportunities, compare protocol risk, liquidity, asset exposure, and operational considerations. Do not execute transactions.
